contents:
[package]
name = "fond-bib"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Hayagriva bibliography model, on-disk vault layout, citation keys — shared Fond crate"
license = "MIT"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.80"
authors = ["Cal St Francis <calstfrancis@gmail.com>"]
repository = "https://github.com/calstfrancis/kartoteka"

[dependencies]
hayagriva = "0.10"
biblatex = "0.11"
serde_yaml_ng = "0.10"
serde_json = "1"
blake3 = "1"
walkdir = "2"
thiserror = "2"

[dependencies.rusqlite]
version = "0.40"
features = ["bundled"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.reqwest]
optional = true
version = "0.12"
default-features = false
features = ["blocking", "rustls-tls", "json"]

[features]
acquire = ["dep:reqwest"]

[dev-dependencies]
tempfile = "3"
blake3 = "1"

[dev-dependencies.rusqlite]
version = "0.40"
features = ["bundled"]

[package]
name = "fond-vault"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Git-backed vault operations and filesystem watching — shared Fond crate"
license = "MIT"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.80"
authors = ["Cal St Francis <calstfrancis@gmail.com>"]
repository = "https://github.com/calstfrancis/kartoteka"

[dependencies]
notify = "6"
thiserror = "2"

[dependencies.git2]
version = "0.20"
default-features = false
features = ["vendored-libgit2", "https"]

[dev-dependencies]
tempfile = "3"

[package]
name = "skrizhal-core"
version = "0.4.0-dev3"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT"
description = "CV entry schema, parsing, and validation for Skrizhal — no GUI dependencies, so Zerkalo (or anything else) can depend on it without pulling in a second copy of GTK4/libadwaita"
homepage = "https://github.com/calstfrancis/skrizhal"
repository = "https://github.com/calstfrancis/skrizhal"

[dependencies]
serde_yaml_ng = "0.10.0"
thiserror = "2.0.18"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0.228"
features = ["derive"]

[dev-dependencies]
tempfile = "3.27.0"

[source.vendored-sources]
directory = "cargo/vendor"

[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/calstfrancis/kartoteka"]
git = "https://github.com/calstfrancis/kartoteka"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
tag = "v0.7.0"

[source."https://github.com/calstfrancis/skrizhal"]
git = "https://github.com/calstfrancis/skrizhal"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
tag = "v0.4.0"
